6/⚡ 3. Volatility-Based

In this approach, the more volatile a coin is, the smaller your position.

> Less volatile means bigger position.

Example: You might size down on $DOGE or $PEPE but go larger on stable performers like $ETH or $XRP.

→ Smart exposure.
